scientific_integrity: Proof of finite-size ground-state classification via incidence-square identity, parity of graph degrees, and a near-regular graphical lemma; small-n exhaustive checks are corroborative, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Classical uniform antiferromagnetic Ising interactions on T_n=L(K_n), n>=4, zero temperature, longitudinal homogeneous field. Exact coefficients count labelled degree-regular graphs; no universal elementary closed coefficient expression is claimed. No positive-temperature, dynamics, quantum or bulk-phase-transition claim.
title: Exact finite-size field staircase and parity-defect transition for the triangular-graph Ising antiferromagnet
